column1: # The Vengeful Wraith: Ashfall's alternate-world Karis. Her identity is
# unrevealed by name. She directs her hatred at Ivan, holds the party in
# contempt, and reveals their relationship only after battle. Enemy row 166
# uses the long name below. Dialogue contexts are called by umbral_rift.c.

column3: You... Of all the people\nI could have met here,\nit had to be you.{end_wait}
Even the sound of your\nvoice disgusts me.{end_wait}
Looks like it's time for me\nto go...{page_break}It's strange...{page_break}Ever since that day, I've\nhated you...{end_wait}
How fitting. Still\nsurrounded by people\nwilling to defend you.{end_wait}
What has Ivan done to\nmake you hate him?{end_wait}
You know nothing. None of\nyou do.{end_wait}
Whatever happened,\nwe won't let you hurt Ivan.{end_wait}
But it was good seeing you\none last time...{end_wait}
No. I've never seen her\nbefore. But the way she\nlooked at me...{end_wait}
I don't know, Mia.\nI don't understand.{end_wait}
